text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Zephyr! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Bakushin O... Oh, and
Rice, too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You both look wonderful, like petals
dancing on
a soft breeze. Are you going
out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah. We're meeting Bourbon at the
school
gate... and then we're going
shopping.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr, um... Why are you wearing your
tracksuit
on the weekend?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm going to do some running. I
wish to feel
the blazing wind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: FANTASTIC!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're super hyped for your next
goal—the New
Zealand Trophy! As class
rep, I'm giving you an
A+ for effort!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you very much... Well, if you'll
excuse
me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Zephyr's amazing... Her aura felt
so
intense just now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She's so strong... She must be really
determined.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's already empty...
Wait, is that... Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heeeya! ♪ Doing some running? And on
the
weekend, too... You're wayyy too
dedicated.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding! I'm out running too! Heh
heh.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Tokai Teio... A gifted runner in my year.
To fans
and the media, she's a rising
star.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And to me...)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Byyyy the wayyy! Aren't you thirsty? You're thirsty, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Mmm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! This really hits the spot after some running! That refreshing honey flavor with a hint of lemon!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well? How is it? I know you've got kind
of a
particular palate, but there's no
denying that
all-natural taste, right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It is very delicious. There's a gentle
sweetness and
a refreshing tang to it... It
feels as though a
breeze is caressing my
throat.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I have no idea what you mean, but
if you
like it, that's great!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since we're already hitting the
honeyade, how
about we make a
bee-line to one last spot!
C'mon, follow
me!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... She's about as lively as a
typhoon.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr! What are you waiting for?
C'mon already!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Don't worry, I'm on my way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...It's quiet.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(On race days, the turbulent winds blow
so hard
they make me dizzy. But today,
it's so still out
here...)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...You know, I like doing this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gazing out at Tokyo Racecourse when
it's quiet
like this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, when I'm out here...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I think back to the day Prez won the
Japanese
Derby, taking one step closer
to becoming an
undefeated Triple
Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The cheers, the heat of the moment...
the
emotions that surged through my
body...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can remember all of it so clearly!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
When summer's over, fall and winter just
fly by,
you know? Then, New Year's will
be here before
you know it...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then it'll be spring of our classic year.
And that
means the start of Triple Crown
season!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win it. Just wait and see—I
won't let
anything stand in my way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become an undefeated Triple
Crown
champion—just like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Yes... This wind... This lovely, wistful
wind...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Amazing! She is AMAZING!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr & Teio
text_block_list.text: I want to be like that too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: There's a word for this...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Yep!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd get it, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes, I do.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I know the feeling very, very well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm heading back to the trainers'
dorm in the
evening, I spot Yamanin
Zephyr and Tokai Teio in
their
tracksuits.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm in Ritto, so I'll catch you later!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... See you again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? It's you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... Not just running, though.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: In fact...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr quietly explains what
she and
Tokai Teio spoke about. It
sounds like she had a
really good time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Teio and I... we're both chasing the
welkin wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking on the mile tour, while her
sights are
set on the Triple Crown.
Although the wind
streams we mean to
follow differ...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: We are rivals nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I sense the still of evening. Our
day off has
already come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, I look forward to training
tomorrow.
